title: A defined brainstem circuit for cardiac control
abstract: A distinct neuropeptide Y2 receptor-expressing neuronal subtype is identified in the brainstem nucleus ambiguus that selectively projects to cardiac ganglia and regulates heart rate and the mammalian diving reflex.
abstract_zh: 在脑干核模糊中鉴定出一种特异性表达Y2受体的神经元亚型，该亚型选择性投射至心脏神经节并调节心率和哺乳动物潜水反射。
